name: net_orders_wait_for_the_match
description: A networked window takes no orders before START or after its link is lost, and says so: while it waits for the partner and while it loads, A and N are refused with 'The match has not started', the commands are greyed, the countdown and the horn's early gold are hidden, and a click builds nothing; once the match runs they work; after the link goes they are refused again with 'No link to the server', the placement mode drops, and the party strip's link bars go dark and its Ready marks hide. My own Ready mark lights from my press at once.

steps.assert: node('BuildController').mode == '' and node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == 'The match has not started'
steps.msg: Q is refused, and says why
the commands are greyed
a click on the field orders nothing

steps.assert: not Game.accepts_commands() and Game.command_refusal() == 'The match has not started'
steps.msg: waiting for the partner, orders go nowhere
loading, the hollow stands but a free cell is not offered
the frozen countdown and the horn's early gold are hidden

steps.assert: not node('BuildController').wants_ready() and node('BuildController').settled() and node('Notice').text == 'The match has not started'
steps.msg: N is refused too

steps.assert: not node('BuildController').build('arrow', Vector2i(8, 3)) and node('Pending_8_3') == null
steps.msg: and so is a build

steps.assert: Game.accepts_commands() and not node('CardQ').disabled and not node('Ready').disabled
steps.msg: the match runs: the commands light
and the countdown shows
Q picks the arrow tower now
a click builds once the turn comes
the strip shows both seats' Ready marks and link bars

steps.assert: node('PartyStrip').lines()[0].ends_with(' ready') and node('Countdown').text.ends_with('Ready 1/2') and not Game.is_ready()
steps.msg: my own Ready mark and the count light at once from my press, as the horn does, before the turn comes

steps.assert: node('PartyStrip').lines()[0].ends_with(' ready') and not node('PartyStrip').lines()[1].ends_with(' ready')
steps.msg: and stays lit once the simulation has it; the partner's is not

steps.assert: not Game.accepts_commands() and Game.command_refusal() == 'No link to the server'
steps.msg: the link is gone: orders go nowhere
the placement mode goes with the link: no grid, no ghost, no lit slot
the strip's link bars go dark and its Ready marks hide

steps.assert: node('BuildController').mode == '' and node('Notice').text == 'No link to the server'
steps.msg: Q is refused, and says why
a click orders nothing

steps.assert: node('BuildController').mode == '' and node('CardW').disabled and node('Ready').disabled and node('Countdown').text == ''
steps.msg: W is refused; the commands and the countdown stay dark
the strip says the link is lost
